unchanged_fields.finite_boundary: all action words of lengths 1 through 3
unchanged_fields.behavioral_deduplication: retain the first candidate in this frozen order for each distinct finite trace signature
unchanged_fields.admission: exact P0 replay, complete fixed bytes and provenance, local reset, offline execution, deterministic output under PYTHONHASHSEED 0,1,5,10 with two fresh-process repetitions, no forbidden runtime event

candidate_order.checkpoint_rule: round-robin by ascending iteration number across the frozen run order max then xhigh; if one run has no tag at an iteration, continue with the available run; stop after eight behaviorally unique admitted candidates or after all retained tags are exhausted
candidate_order.rationale: balance the two separately sampled runs before taking deeper checkpoints from either one; the rule is source/provenance based and was fixed before any checkpoint behavior was executed

screening_rule.provisional: run exact P0 replay and one complete seed-0 finite-boundary process; candidates whose trace signature duplicates an earlier candidate are recorded and not admitted
screening_rule.promotion: a provisionally unique candidate must then pass the complete eight-process seed/repetition requirement before admission
screening_rule.no_shortcut_claim: a rejected duplicate receives no determinism claim beyond tests actually run

scope_boundary: candidate acquisition and finite behavioral deduplication only; no OIA separator synthesis, real ARC action, paid/model/API call, credential use, sealed environment or Track B claim
